name: AgentScope
summary: Python agent framework with ReAct loops, tools and MCP/skills integration, context compaction, memory, permission checks and isolated execution backends.
description: Install with uv pip install agentscope (PyPI 2.0.11; Python 3.11+). AgentScope 2.0 provides reasoning/acting, interruption and resume, tool management, multimodal events, middleware, permission and human-confirmation controls. Memory backends include ReMe and Mem0; workspaces support local, container and sandbox backends. Apache-2.0 source is freely available; model-provider and sandbox services are separate.

agent_access.notes: Public source repository; local library. Model services and compute have separate requirements and costs.
